latestVersion.changelog:
Subtitle Generator by Link — Initial Release

- Instantly generate captioned videos from YouTube and online video links with AI subtitles in 30–90 seconds.
- Automatic session setup and token management; supports both registered and anonymous users.
- Simple export workflows for 1080p MP4s and other popular formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, etc.).
- Easily check credits, upload videos by URL or file, and monitor session state in real time.
- Robust error handling for authentication, credits, file size, and export eligibility.
- Designed for concise, no-fuss video captioning—just paste your link and describe what you want.
